text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Kikuka Sho—the final
race of
the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're finally here at the biggest event
of the
autumn season.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Did you know there are superstitions
about each
of the three Classic races?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The fastest Umamusume excels in the
Satsuki
Sho, the luckiest excels in the
Derby...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And in the Kikuka Sho... it's the
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I've come here to show my
strength—that's my
plan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you're number one when it comes to ability!
Yeah, when it comes to sheer ability, you're number one!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I think your idea of strength might be a
little
different from mine.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, the strength I'm talking about is...
choice_data_list_en: Wasn't it because of your own skill?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We didn't choose each other based on
talent or
other measures.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We were true to our feelings... and chose
the
person we wanted most by our side.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's why we were both able to get
back on our
feet so magnificently after
going through the
hardships we did.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We have an irreplaceable bond... And
that's
why...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm going to show it to everyone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I will! Wait for me with open arms at the
finish
line, my Trainer.
choice_data_list: 頑張って、スーパークリーク！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something inside her has burst open. I'm
sure this
unrestrained Super Creek will
get the job done!
